action.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT dept_id, SUM(debit - credit) AS actual FROM gl_lines WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND period = '2026-04' AND account_id BETWEEN '6000' AND '6999' GROUP BY dept_id), b AS (SELECT dept_id, SUM(amount) AS budget FROM budgets WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND period = '2026-04' AND account_id BETWEEN '6000' AND '6999' GROUP BY dept_id) SELECT COALESCE(a.dept_id, b.dept_id) AS dept_id FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b ON a.dept_id = b.dept_id WHERE COALESCE(a.actual, 0) > COALESCE(b.budget, 0) ORDER BY dept_id
